newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIA BANCOREX BANK CUTS LEU DEPOSIT RATES.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIA BANCOREX BANK CUTS LEU DEPOSIT RATES.

text.p: Romanian state-run bank Bancorex SA said on Thursday it would lower term-deposit rates on individuals' leu deposits starting Friday.
The move follows recent eases in banks' deposit rates and lower money market rates due to leu overliquidity.
A bank statement said annual rate on one-month deposits would be cut to 95 percent from 105 percent, with the rate on three-month deposits slipping to 90 percent from 95 percent.
Six-month deposit will pay 80 percent annual interest, down from 85 percent, while nine-month deposit will carry a rate of 75 percent, 10 points down from 85 percent.
The annual rate on one-year deposits will be 75 percent, down from a current 80 percent.
